corrections.why: OpenStreetMap maps the point but says nothing about its condition, and no other source read confirms that the tower stands

notes_for_editor: Not confirmed as a fire lookout. OSM tags it tower:type=observation and gives no builder, date or height. None of the seven NHLR Michigan names or the two FFLOS names matches it. Mapcarta places it in Quincy Township near Ruby Marsh and Lake Annie. The record's 'standing' is not backed by any source read. Next: Michigan DNR fire tower records or Houghton County local history for this site. Do not publish as a fire lookout until a source says so.
